title: AI on client work, *safely*
subtitle: Your clients trust you with their files. Keep it that way.

left.title: Don't
items: Paste client files into free AI
Let AI quote prices or deadlines
Hide AI use if the client asks

right.title: Do
items: Check your contract or NDA first
Be open about how you use AI

takeaway: AI does the draft. *You* own the result.
